american-express-gold-card: Strong 4x on dining and groceries; the fee stings outside cities.
blue-cash-preferred-card: Grocery and streaming cash back covers the fee; the cap bites some.
capital-one-savor: High cash back on dining and fun; a few accounts closed unexplained.
capital-one-venture-x: Travel credit and miles offset the fee; the portal credit is clunky.
chase-freedom-flex: Rotating categories lift returns; a hassle to track for some.
chase-freedom-unlimited: Everyday card often paired with Sapphire; less competitive now.
citi-double-cash: Simple flat-rate card many keep for years; Citi service frustrates.
everydollar: Simple zero-based budgeting some prefer to YNAB; clunky to critics.
fidelity-brokerage-account: Highly rated service, all in one place; some transfers get held.
fidelity-cash-management-account: Dependable checking with free ATMs; slow bill pay and transfers.
freetaxusa: Cheap, accurate and free federal filing; few direct imports.
monarch: Mint-style overview many switched to; some accounts stop syncing.
the-platinum-card-from-american-express: Lounges and hotels repay frequent travellers; a coupon book to others.
wells-fargo-active-cash: Simple no-fee flat rate with phone cover; redemption rules irk.
wise: Low, upfront fees and good rates abroad; some accounts get blocked.
